svg.title: Natural, tangent-predictor and PAL tracks near a branch birth and a verified fold.
svg.desc: English: Natural, tangent-predictor and PAL tracks near a branch birth and a verified fold. 繁體中文：分支誕生及已驗證 fold 附近的 natural、tangent-predictor 與 PAL 追蹤。

cc:Work.dc:description: Actual saved tracks, with no replacement of failed runs. Panel (a) follows the identical near-origin M=4 zero-phase seed using previous-state natural, its separately named tangent-predictor variant, and PAL. Panel (b) uses zip-M2-phase2 around the fold N0=87.52264712, verified by the separate post-hoc saved-PAL-turn audit when a supplement is supplied. It displays the frozen source PAL track and other methods with matching initial load, root and direction, within N_event-0.8 to N_event+1.2; missing matching methods are none. The coordinate is (q-q_event) dotted with the saved unit Hessian null vector, not physical displacement. Only accepted original-gradient roots are connected; failed or outside-window intervals are never bridged. All rejected trials remain in the input records. Natural load and PAL arclength steps are not equivalent progress units. Local track behavior does not replace original aggregate coverage or identify physical transitions.
